original_question: Jerry yana mirgina kwado mai gefuna shida. Nawa ne (an bayyana da percentage) ya mirgina lamba fiye da 3 fiye da kuma cewa ya mirgina lambobi biyu a jere?
question_template: {name_male, Jerry} yana mirgina kwado mai gefuna {num_text_1, shida}. Nawa ne (an bayyana da percentage) ya mirgina lamba fiye da {num_digit_1, 3} fiye da kuma cewa ya mirgina lambobi {num_text_2, biyu} a jere?
question_solution:
even_count = num_text_1 / 2  # number of even faces
answer = ((num_text_1 - num_digit_1) / num_text_1 - (even_count / num_text_1) ** num_text_2) * 100

num_text_1: Dari daya da ashirin da biyar
